# Check runs every commit must pass before it can be released, one name per
# line: the status-check contexts branch protection requires on main.
# scripts/verify-ci.sh, run by release.yml's verify-ci job, fails the release
# unless each one concluded success on the tag's commit. Only checks that run
# on push to main belong here (TestRequiredChecksRunOnPushToMain): a
# pull_request-only check never runs on the tag's commit.
test (ubuntu-latest)
test (macos-latest)
test (windows-latest)
lint
vulncheck
snapshot
install-scripts (ubuntu-latest, bash scripts/install.sh --dry-run)
install-scripts (windows-latest, pwsh scripts/install.ps1 -DryRun)
